target_customer: Contractors and construction trades businesses buying commercial insurance
problem: Contractors struggle to get coverage fast, shop carriers and manage certificates of insurance and contract insurance requirements.
business_model: Insurance brokerage paid commission by the carrier when a policy is bound, with AI tools for submissions and compliance

founders.name: Daniel Siryakov
founders.background_notes: YC bio says former AI product manager and machine learning engineer who built systematic investment strategies; employers not named on the page.

competitors.name: Shepherd
competitors.funding_then: 13.5M USD Series in February 2024 per SiliconANGLE headline

competitors.name: Counterpart
competitors.what: Agentic insurance platform with construction coverage

technical_complexity.rationale: Brokerage workflow automation with agents that log into agency systems and carrier portals; mostly integration and domain work, with licensing as the barrier.

defensibility.rationale: Broker licensing and carrier relationships help, but brokerages are numerous and AI tooling is available to all.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Funded construction insurance startups already operated; Shepherd raised a larger round in 2026 per Axios and Pulse 2.0 headlines.

market_need_then: Contractors need certificates of insurance, many carriers and contract compliance; the company says it serves contractors in all 50 states through carrier partners.

identity.logo: present on YC page, not described
identity.voice_and_tone: Plain broker language; page offers free quotes and says carriers pay when you bind

brand_strength.rationale: No brand coverage found; acolite is also a mineral name and an ocean color software term, and the company positioned under different names in different sources.

outcome_analysis: Acolite is a Spring 2025 YC company that is active with a founder from machine learning and legal tech. It is positioned as an AI native broker for contractors, while an earlier launch post found only on a mirror site described AI teammates for insurance agencies. No verified funding or exit was found, so no outcome can be assigned beyond continued operation.
notes: Unverified: Caplight lists an Accelerator tagged round of 100K USD dated 2022-08, which predates founding and is not recorded as a round. Location conflict: YC says Philadelphia, Caplight says New York. A search snippet names a second founder, Barak Ben Noon, but the YC page does not, so he is not listed. A mirror site shows a YC launch titled AI teammates for insurance agencies, not confirmed on ycombinator.com, so no pivot recorded. The Shepherd competitor source is dated 2024-02. Completeness pass: the $100K accelerator round dated 2022-08-23 rests on a single database (Caplight) and predates the 2024 founding year.
